name: mobaxterm-import
description: Import MobaXterm sessions as electerm bookmarks

electerm.name: MobaXterm Import
electerm.description: Reads MobaXterm sessions (MobaXterm.ini or an exported .mxtsessions file) and offers them as bookmarks: SSH, SFTP, Telnet, RDP and VNC, folders become bookmark groups. Nothing is added until you press "Import bookmarks". Needs electerm with widget bookmark offers.

configs.name: file
configs.label: MobaXterm file
configs.description: MobaXterm.ini or a .mxtsessions export. Empty: %APPDATA%\MobaXterm\MobaXterm.ini (installed MobaXterm, the portable one keeps it next to its exe).

configs.name: group
configs.label: Bookmark group
configs.description: New group that takes the sessions, MobaXterm folders become subgroups.
